prDraft.title: Fix: chunked() silently drops trailing items when the length is not a multiple of size
prDraft.body:
## Problem
chunked() drops the final partial chunk, so inputs whose length is not a multiple of size lose items.
## Fix
The range stopped at len(items) - size + 1, which skips the start index of a final partial chunk. Iterating up to len(items) keeps it.
## Verification
- `tests/test_chunked_trailing.py` fails on the current code (AssertionError on the first two cases: the trailing partial chunk is missing).
- The same test passes with this patch, and the full pytest suite passes.

_Reproduced and verified by executing the tests, generated with ReproPilot (NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory)._
